tasks.title: Rename app title from 'Chris Min Calculator' to 'Chris Min Calc'
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Rename the calculator app title from 'Chris Min Calculator' to 'Chris Min Calc' across all files where the app name appears.
2. READ FIRST: Read index.html (line 7 has the <title> tag) and README.md (line 1 has the project heading). Also search the full codebase with grep for 'Chris Min Calculator' to catch any other occurrences.
3. FILES: Modify index.html — change <title>Chris Min Calculator</title> to <title>Chris Min Calc</title>. Modify README.md — change '# Chris Min Calculator' to '# Chris Min Calc'. If the current title is 'Mini Calculator' rather than 'Chris Min Calculator', update all occurrences of 'Mini Calculator' to 'Chris Min Calc' in both files.
4. APPROACH: Simple text substitution. No logic changes. Check index.html title tag and README.md heading. Run grep for both 'Chris Min Calculator' and 'Mini Calculator' to find all occurrences.
5. PATTERNS: No existing pattern to follow — this is a cosmetic text change only.
acceptance_criteria: index.html <title> tag contains 'Chris Min Calc' and not 'Chris Min Calculator' or 'Mini Calculator'
README.md first heading reads '# Chris Min Calc'
grep for 'Chris Min Calculator' returns no matches across the entire project
